hero.headline: The whole of MicrOasis 2026, in your pocket
hero.sub: The full timetable for every stage, a live NOW view and Apple Watch widgets, so you always know when each act starts.

showcase.featuresHeading: Everything you need on the ground

timetable.title: A continuous, day-by-day view
timetable.body: Every stage gets its own column, so at a glance you see the overlaps, the gaps, and how much time you have between two acts. Choose how many columns to show at once, and change the text size too.

now.title: The “Now” view
now.body: It shows, stage by stage, what’s playing right now and who’s up next, with a countdown on whatever is currently running — the whole festival’s pulse on one screen. And before the gates open it counts down to the start, so you know exactly how long is left.

favorites.title: Favorites, one tap away
favorites.body: Tap an act in the timetable and it gets a red heart. The heart button in the header spotlights your favorites — everything else fades, so you instantly see where you’re headed next. Your favorites sync automatically between iPhone and Apple Watch.

widgets.title: Widgets on your home screen
widgets.body: Put your favorite stages on the home screen: the widget shows what’s playing right now and who’s up next — without even opening the app. Drag them into a stack and every stage sits one flick apart. A tap jumps straight to that stage’s timetable, and your favorites’ hearts are right there on it.

settings.title: Set it up your way
settings.body: Drag the stages into the order you actually walk the festival, and hide the ones you’re not following. Switch between Hungarian and English with a single tap, and set the text size or the number of columns.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: After the first load the whole schedule stays on your device — it keeps working even with a weak signal in a crowd.

location.title: The nearest stage
location.body: If you allow it, your location highlights the stage nearest you. Open the app and, from the time and place, you immediately see where you are.

android.title: On Android too
android.body: No separate app needed: add the web version to your home screen straight from the browser, and from then on it opens just like a native app.

watch.title: It’s right there on your wrist
watch.body: The whole programme in a native watchOS app: one stage, one act at a time — just as much as you take in at a single glance.
watch.swipeBody: Swipe up and down to move through the acts, left and right to change stage — always anchored to the same moment in time, so browsing never drifts away from now.
watch.widgetBody: Raise your wrist and the Smart Stack already shows what’s on. Pin one per stage, add them all, and turn the crown to page between them — plus watch-face complications, so a glance really is all it takes.

cta.title: Take the whole programme with you
cta.body: Download it free and every stage of MicrOasis 2026 is in your pocket and on your wrist — offline, too.
